body:
New src/gseq.h/.c: GSeq/GSeqPlayer chain multiple .gband clips with real nlerp crossfade, channel-name lookup against a GSkel, rest-pose fallback for unmatched joints. 15 real test assertions (test_gseq.c), wired into build_and_test.sh. Commit GOLDENBAND a3b452e.
